name: MKT_CM_PERSONALIZATIONS
description: When executing the sales campaign, a marketeer may want to send a personalized message to some contacts.This table stores the personalized text information for a List member, with respect to treatment and stage.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CALL_LST_ID
columns.description: Call Lst Id. FK to MKT_CALL_LST table

columns.name: TREATMENT_ID
columns.description: Treatment Id. FK to MKT_TM_TREATMENTS table

columns.name: STAGE_ID
columns.description: Stage Id. FK to MKT_CM_STAGES table

columns.name: PERSONALIZED_TEXT
columns.description: Stores personalized text for a party_id in context with relationship _id, call_lst_id, treatment_id and stage_id.

columns.name: EMAIL_BCC
columns.description: Stores Email Bcc for a party_id in context with relationship _id, call_lst_id, treatment_id and stage_id.

columns.name: EMAIL_CC
columns.description: Stores Email Cc for a party_id in context with relationship _id, call_lst_id, treatment_id and stage_id.
